note: From the Louisiana Secretary of State's candidate list and sample ballots for all 219 East Baton Rouge Parish precincts. Parish and Metro Council offices and the Mayor-President were elected in 2024 and are not on this ballot. Unopposed candidates (most 19th Judicial District Court divisions, Juvenile Court and Family Court Election Section 1 Division B and Section 3 Division D) were declared elected and do not appear on the ballot. Not shown (they depend on a district or section the address lookup cannot resolve): 19th Judicial District Court Election Section 1 Divisions L and M; Family Court Election Section 2 Division C and Election Section 3 Division A; School Board districts (East Baton Rouge, Baker, Central and Zachary systems); Justice of the Peace and Constable; Baker City Court; City of Central and City of Zachary offices; and crime prevention district parcel fees. The City of Baton Rouge has no citywide item on this ballot. Check your official sample ballot for these.

measures.title: Parishwide Proposition - .50 Mills Renewal - MC - 10 Yrs.
measures.summary: Renews East Baton Rouge Parish's 0.50-mill property tax for ten years, 2027 through 2036. The money is used to buy, maintain and operate equipment and facilities for controlling mosquitoes, other disease-carrying arthropods and rodents, and for the staff that run the program. The tax is expected to raise about $3,135,435 a year.
measures.yesMeans: The parish may keep levying the 0.50-mill mosquito and rodent control tax from 2027 through 2036.
measures.noMeans: The parish may not renew this 0.50-mill tax.
